narrative.overview: The page is the stack of painted tin boards that hangs over every chai stall: the shop's own maroon, white letters with a turmeric shade, a keyline a brush width in from the edge, prices on dotted leaders. The boards hang over the real Concord room and over painted walls of maroon, turmeric and tea-black. One motion idea runs the page: things are hung, so they swing and settle.
keyCharacteristics: Committed color: maroon carries the boards and about half the sections; turmeric is the second paint.
Painted display letters with a hard shade, condensed rate-board caps, plain body.
Real photos only, in frames sized to their resolution.
Swing-and-settle motion from a top pivot, driven by scroll or by entering view.
Phone first: a three-button board pinned to the bottom of the screen.

rules.name: The Two Paints Rule
rules.body: Every field is maroon, turmeric or tea-black, and every board is maroon, turmeric, enamel or tea. A board never sits on a field of its own color.

rules.name: The Clay Stays in the Cup Rule
rules.body: Terracotta appears only in the drawn kullad and its spices; it is not an accent.

rules.name: The Painted Shade Rule
rules.body: Shrikhand always carries its shade: a hard text-shadow at 0.045em / 0.055em, no blur. It is never used as a box shadow.

rules.name: The Heading Speaks Alone Rule
rules.body: No label above a heading. Specs and legends go under titles or label form groups.

rules.name: The Nothing Floats Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from hanging, not glass: no backdrop blur, no glow. Anything raised is hung on cords or nailed, and swings from its top edge.

dos: Do take every price from the screens over the counter and note anything new in CONFIRM.md.
Do keep the painted shade on Shrikhand and keep Shrikhand to headings, board titles and the wordmark.
Do hang new things: pivot from the top, spring in, settle (rotate 2.4deg to 0, stiffness 90, damping 6).
Do size photos to their source: only gm22 goes full bleed; Reel stills stay in 4:5 frames under 430px wide.
Do write in the owner's first person, short sentences, headings as sentences with a period.
donts: Don't put a label above a heading.
Don't use AI imagery, stock, or the shop's AI marketing graphics as photos.
Don't add glass, glow, gradient text or a second accent color.
Don't drive a horizontal row with vertical scroll.
Don't imitate hardware (metal screws, bevels, embossing); the boards are paint.
